messages.subject: Compare nested lavaan-models build by multiple imputed datasets
parts:
I´ve calculated latent change score models in lavaan with multiple imputed data using the function lavaan.mi - after that I want to compare my nested models  like anova does in lavaan but it doesn´t work because of my imputed structure. 

Do you have any suggestions how this could be done? I would be very thankful for any suggestions. 

Thanks,
Sophie

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Compare nested lavaan-models build by multiple imputed datasets
parts: I did not found any information about interpreting this result, what does it say about my model comparison?

It's a LRT.  The chi-squared statistic is the one labeled "chisq", its degrees of freedom are labeled "df", and the probability of that chi-squared when the H0 is true (i.e., when the more constrained nested model fits as well as the less constrained parent model) is labeled "pvalue".  The ARIV and FMI are diagnostics quantifying how much efficiency the pooled statistic loses relative to having complete data (read Enders book for more info, listed on the help-page references).

parts: Late reply, but you can also use compareFit() from semTools. As stated in the documentation, "lavaan.mi objects are also accepted, but all models must belong to the same class". This method also allows you to perform LRTs of one model vs multiple other (nested) models.
